title: append answer
description: The memory tool append's answer (SB-P3-09): a dated update added to a memory, the text before kept as a version. No memory's words, only where it is and what changed. Listed and answered only with memory.tools on (contracts/README.md 2.1). The JSON in its text content, and on success the same as its structured content; a refusal is isError true with the refusal body.
